text: The Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment as the Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner.

The Nominating Panel - Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment as Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner: Candidate #RHL1-20 Candidate #RHL1-37 Candidate #RHL2-3 Candidate #RHL2-6 Candidate #RHL2-14 Candidate #RHL2-19 Candidate #RHL2-27 Candidate #RHL2-31 Candidate #RHL2-38 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (May 17, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment as the Rooming House Licensing Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner.
